purpose: Curated cover-trade-dress authority for Sunforge Outlaw image production. The approved/public-preview Issue 1 cover anchors masthead and recurring cover brand language; issue-specific RexPrompt cover recipes control each later cover's actual selling image.

rules: Before generating any Sunforge Outlaw cover, retrieve and visually inspect the actual Issue 1 cover pixels. A path, filename, SHA, summary or remembered description is not a substitute for pixel readback.
Issue 1 cover controls masthead, logo/trade-dress architecture, typography character, issue-number rhythm, border/edge behavior, and recurring cover-brand language.
Issue 1 cover does not control later issue scene composition, cast arrangement, focal object, setting, or symbolic logic. Those come from the active assembled RexPrompt cover recipe.
Interior pages and editorial splashes are not cover trade-dress authority.
Do not allow cover-to-cover drift by using only the immediately preceding generated cover. Re-anchor to the Issue 1 trade-dress reference for every cover.

references.use: Mandatory pixel-read reference before every Sunforge Outlaw cover generation. Use for recurring cover identity only; do not force later covers to repeat Issue 1 composition.

sessionStartGate: Assemble the exact active cover recipe from RexPrompt.
Retrieve any needed character/environment references required by the assembled recipe.
Use Issue 1 cover for trade dress; use the current recipe for the issue-specific selling image.
Generate only after the visual reference set is actually present in active multimodal context.
coverAudit: Does the cover read at thumbnail size?
Is there one dominant selling idea?
Does the trade dress visibly belong to the Issue 1 line?
Is the issue-specific composition distinct from other covers?
Does the cover entice without revealing a later payoff?
Are recurring characters on-model against their proper visual authorities?
Is all environmental/promotional text absent unless explicitly required by approved trade dress?
